headline: Blackhawks’ Patrick Kane to miss time with upper-body injury
take:
Patrick Kane will miss time with an upper-body injury, Daily Faceoff reports, noting he has a goal and eight assists for nine points this season. Scott Powers of The Athletic posted that Kane "will miss the next couple games."

The points hide a rougher start. Kane has scored one goal on 3.11 expected goals so far this season (a measure of the quality of his chances), so he is about two goals short of what those looks should have produced. At five-on-five, CHI has taken only 36% of the expected goals with him on the ice, and the team's share runs about seven points worse with him out there. That is a small sample, but it fits a CHI side sitting 4-9-1 with a 43% share of expected goals overall.

The ice time is the real question. Our numbers have no games played without him yet, so this is a projection based on how the coach has used his players. Teuvo Teravainen, at 16:32 a night, is next in line for his minutes, and Anton Frondell, the busiest man on the second power-play unit, is the likeliest to step onto the first.
